scope: v0.2 checkpoint; diagnostic seeds only; six frames per video inspected plus simulator telemetry

examples.evidence: Cube is grasped and lifted; repeated lift/lower motion does not settle at the goal.
Arm remains near the starting pose and does not reach the cube; action replay confirms the controller itself works.
Arm reaches near the cube, but does not secure it; cube is pushed across the table.
Cube is grasped and transported near the goal, but the arm does not satisfy goal-and-static success.

uncertainty: Phase labels are descriptive. These videos do not isolate architecture, dataset coverage or optimization as causal mechanisms.
